honors.title: President Honor's Role
honors.description: The president honors award is awarded to LAVC students who appeared on the part-time or full-time dean honor list, three times. In order to appear on the part-time dean honor list by taking 6-11 units. You must complete these semesters with a 3.5+ GPA.

honors.title: Key Club- Distinguished President
honors.description: I had collected 244 community service hours, with nearly a 100% attendance rate at the community service events. Despite the small club at first, I developed a prospering club, largest in school history. Created multiple partnerships with differents school and business; for example, working with with organization called Border Angeles to raise and bring human necessities for the people stuck in border towns.

volunteerExperiences.description: The organization strives to benefit one's community and develop the students into leaders. Key Club volunteers at marathons, food drives, and much more. The club develops the members' communication skills, professionalism, and responsibility. This is all down creating a smile on the members faces and allows the ability to network and work with countless organizations.

Everybody Reads, a volunteer reading and book gifting program run entirely by volunteers since early 2001. The program allows students to destress by communicating their thoughts with their group. The program develops the student's reading abilities and creates a safe space for communicating. During this experience I worked with the students and talked about emotions and more importantly how to deal with them.

projects.title: Deep Learning Architectures & Training Pipeline
projects.description:
Implemented neural networks from scratch using NumPy and batch normalization, ensuring operations worked on mini batches
Implemented forward and backward passes for ReLU, Softmax, Cross-Entropy loss, Fully Connected, Convolutional, and Pooling layers, validating correctness with unit tests and gradient checking.
Used PyTorch for CNNs on Fashion MNIST, performed transfer learning on CIFAR-10, achieving >84% and ~80% test accuracy.

projects.title: Midas: Webcam-Based Facial Expression Analysis
projects.description:
Over the span of 45 hours
Used Reflex to implement a real-time facial recognition system utilizing Hume webcam technology to analyze emotions
Integrated a LLM that generated autonomous feedback based on emotional data, offering insights with decision making
Presented in a conference with 1500+ attendees, ranking top three at CalHack’s Best AI x Crypto.
